subject.title: refactor(config): retire flat streaming keys from the last six channel schemas via doctor migration

question: Should this release preserve the shipped third-party Plugin SDK schema/type compatibility window, or intentionally break it now?
rationale: Repository policy and merged history favor preserving shipped third-party API, but accepting immediate schema and source breakage is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve the compatibility window
options.body: Split bundled nested-only schemas from the public primitive and retain deprecated flat schema/type fields temporarily.

options.title: Break the public contract now
options.body: Explicitly approve immediate third-party schema and source breakage with versioned migration guidance and live external-plugin upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve the compatibility window
recommendation.body: Split bundled nested-only schemas from the public primitive and retain deprecated flat schema/type fields temporarily.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history connects this owner to both the migration program and the temporary external compatibility behavior.
